name: disk-0 MADNESS
author: Max Curzi
description: Absorb enemies of your own color, dodge the rest and trigger bombs to recolor them. Survive as long as you can. Up to 4 players with several gamepads. X switches color.

descriptions.en: Absorb enemies of your own color, dodge the rest and trigger bombs to recolor them. Survive as long as you can. Up to 4 players with several gamepads. X switches color.
descriptions.it: Assorbi i nemici del tuo colore, evita gli altri e fai esplodere le bombe per cambiarne il colore. Resisti più che puoi. Fino a 4 giocatori con più joypad. X cambia colore.
